arguments.text: The expanded polynomial ansatz found 29 candidate classes modulo840; remaining residues are [1, 121, 169, 289, 361, 529]. Unlike the first constant-divisor attempt, the new formulas use divisors proportional to nx and a varying residual for n=7c-2. Each candidate will now be verified independently for every nonnegative integer parameter, including identity, integrality, positivity and strict order. This reproduces scoped congruence coverage described in literature; no novelty claim. The eight-step hypothesis has a certified counterexample n=246241 (not claimed globally minimal), even though all4166 tested n=1mod24 below100000 passed.

proposal.falsifier: Any coefficient, integrality or ordering failure invalidates that candidate; uncovered residues block total coverage.
proposal.rationale: Integrate the observed failure and proceed with independent checks of infinite families.
